payload.title: M7 vertical slice design: several agents, several turns, recovery mid-flight

payload.precondition: Design only, no code changed and no quota spent. The live slice should not run until the M4 decision gate is resolved in docs/agent-bus-decision-log.md, which states M7 has no baseline until then. Your call, not mine.
payload.summary: M7 section rewritten and ADR 0007 drafted. Two gaps in the shipped code shaped the design: (1) a task made claimable by _settle_dependents queues no delivery and the dispatcher scans deliveries only, so the M5 graph is inert under managed dispatch; (2) spent.turns is counted in send_message, so a dispatched turn that sends nothing costs the task nothing. Fixes: a claimable task assigned to an enabled managed worker queues its own task delivery in the same transaction, scoped to enrolled workers so the M4 gate and pull-beta records are unchanged; begin_turn counts a dispatched turn while send_message keeps counting only an undispatched one; a task created inside a dispatched turn inherits the unspent remainder of its parent budget. Resume: bus records are the worker's memory, provider-session resume is an optimisation, and the gate rotates the session mid-flow to prove it. Recovery: the dispatcher is killed at every seam of the flow, not only inside a turn, and every managed step is idempotent on <delivery_id>:<step>. Exit gate is offline by construction (./test.sh --agent-bus-managed against rehearsal workers, in --full); the live six-turn run stays behind --spend-quota with --rehearse first.

payload.scope: เขียน section M7 ใน docs/agent-bus-roadmap.md และ ADR ร่างใน docs/adr/ ครอบ multi-agent handoff, resume ข้าม turn, recovery ตอน dispatcher ตายกลาง flow, exit gate ที่พิสูจน์ได้ออฟไลน์, และเงื่อนไข live ที่ต้องขออนุมัติ quota
